# Release notes

Version 24 of the example runtime entered long-term support on 2025-10-28. The first release in that line is v24.11.0, and it raised the default request body limit to 16 KiB.

## Support window

Long-term support lasts 30 months: 12 months of active support, then 18 months of maintenance. Security fixes land in every supported line.

![Release timeline](https://docs.example.com/img/timeline.png)

## Upgrading

Read the migration guide before you upgrade from version 22. Most programs need no change.
